content: Kitumu kya Pholu kwena bana bakondi kala Bayuta
Kikuma kya bwabuna, meni Pholu, mutu wa boloku wa Kidisitu Yesu kikuma kya benu bana lukondi kala Bayuta
Benu lwáyuka kwenu mboti phila ya kiyeka kina kápheka Nzambi muna khenda zandi kikuma kya benu.
Mu nzila ya nzayikusu kátsengwamina kitsweki kya mabanza mandi, bwosu yilusonikinibwa mu khufi.
Mu kutangaka mamana, lwalenda bakula ngangu zina yítambula kikuma kya kisalu kya Kidisitu.
Muna makula mana máhita, diswekamu dina, Nzambi kásengumunadyoku kwena batu; kaasi buthwena, wusengumunidya kwena bathumwa bandi yi bambikudi, muna nzila ya Kitembu.

Diswekamu dyadina dyenina: bana bakondi kala Bayuta bisi tambula kimvwama kimosi yi betu Bayuta; benina phi yi lutu lumosi amana bisi tambula mamboti ma kilangi kimosi, mwena Kidisitu Yesu, muna nzila ya Musamu wa Bukheti.
Muna Musamu wa Bukheti meni wuna, mwamuna yíkitukila musadi, bwosu dyenina kabu dya khenda dina kápheka Nzambi, mu buweti bwandi yi ngolu zandi zina zilutini.
Kinga kwena meni yenina wa khunda kuhita bakwikidi boosu, báhana kabu dina dya kusamuna Musamu wa Bukheti wa kimvwama kya mvula yi mvula kya Kidisitu, kwena bana bakondi kala Bayuta

amana yilubula ku mwini, kikuma kya batu boosu, mutindu wuna kisi lungisila Nzambi dibanza dya diswekamu dyandi kikuma kya batu boosu. Yandi wáhanga bima byosu, wásweka diswekamu dina muna makula moosu
ndangu mudimu wa Nzambi, muna bitini byandi bya lawu, wazayakana buthwena, mu nzila ya Dibundu, kwena luyalu lwa tsi yi kwena bapfumu bana benina muna mazilu.
Bwosu buna mákala mabanza ma mvula yi mvula mana kisi lungisa Nzambi mwena Kidisitu Yesu Pfumu wetu.
Mwena Kidisitu yi lukwikilu lwetu mwena yandi, thwenina yi kiphwanza mu kubwesuka ku thwala ya Nzambi yi mbundu mosi.
Yilulombini ni lukatulaku kikesa kikuma kya kiwayi kina mbati mona kikuma kya benu: zenina kikuma kya khembu ya benu.
Lungongu lwa Kidisitu
Pfukikidini makungulu mama ku mesu ma Tata;
kwena yandi kyisi tadila kikanda kyosu, muna mazilu yi hana tsi;
ndangu kaluheka, bwosu kyenina kimvwama kya khembu yandi, mu kukala yi kikesa muna moya yi ngolu zina zilutini muna Kitembu kyandi;
amana Kidisitu kazingila muna mbundu yenu muna lukwikilu amana lwazyama, lwakala phi ba kutunga mu lungongu.
Muna bwabuna ndangu lwalenda mu kubakisa ha kimosi yi bakwikidi, buna kwenina kutoka, dingu, kyana yi kuleya kwa lungongu lwa Kidisitu.
Lwazaya phi lungongu lwa Kidisitu -luna lulutini mazaya moosu- amana lwabasa yi kuna kimvwama kyosu kya Nzambi.
Kwena wuna walenda kusala mu kimakulu, hana thandu ya mana thwisi lomba holo thwisi banza, mu nzila ya ngolu zoosu zina zisi sala mwena betu,
kwena yandi, khembu muna Dibundu mu nzila ya Kidisitu Yesu, muna makula moosu, mvula yi mvula! Abwabuna.

footnotes.text: Pholu kamanisidyoku dibanza dya nzila yayi ndangu kayandululadya muna nzila ya 14. Nzila zazi zenina ha kati haha, zibati zonzila kitumu kyandi yi bitsweki bina kafwani mu kusamuna.
